places.name: Porto
past: Founded in Roman times about a forum. Parts of the ancient street grid survive in the core; medieval lanes and subdivided plots grew around them.
The walls were rebuilt on the new trace: earthen ramparts faced in stone, angled bastions and a ditch.
The old tower keep was rebuilt as a great castle on the same ground.

places.name: Vau de Águia
past: Founded in Roman times about a forum, on the rise above the river. Parts of the ancient street grid survive in the core; medieval lanes and subdivided plots grew around them.
The town outgrew its walls. The new circuit keeps 79% of the old wall and runs out only where the suburbs had spread; a stretch of the old wall inside was pulled down for a street along its line.
A great fire burned 23 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.
The Dominicans were given ground by the wall for their friary.
A great fire burned 18 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.
A great fire burned 37 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.

places.name: Massarelos
past: Founded in Roman times about a forum, on the rise above the river. Parts of the ancient street grid survive in the core; medieval lanes and subdivided plots grew around them.
The ford was bridged in stone.
The town outgrew its walls. The new circuit keeps 82% of the old wall and runs out only where the suburbs had spread; 1 houses were built into what was left of it.
A great fire burned 12 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.

places.name: Cedofeita
past: Farms and an alehouse about a green where the roads meet; a weekly market was granted in its second age.
Walled.
The town outgrew its walls. The new circuit keeps 90% of the old wall and runs out only where the suburbs had spread.
The walls were rebuilt on the new trace: earthen ramparts faced in stone, angled bastions and a ditch; 12 houses outside were cleared for the glacis.
A citadel was raised astride the walls on the southern side; 27 houses of the old quarter were razed for it and its glacis, and a garrison quartered there for good.

places.name: Vila Nova de Gaia
past: A handful of farms about a green, where the plough-land is good.

places.name: Porto Bravo
past: Began as a row of fishers’ huts above the shingle.

places.name: Vilaserra
past: Settled on the riverbank for the water and the fishing.

places.name: Outeiro Ruiva
past: Huts of miners under the scarp, where the ore comes near the surface.
